Indian optical and digital [[technology company]], headquartered in [[Pune]]. It is listed on [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] and [[National Stock Exchange of India]]. It has 780+{{Cite web|url=https://patents.justia.com/assignee/sterlite-technologies-limited|title = Patents Assigned to Sterlite Technologies Limited – Justia Patents Search}} patents and is active in over 150 countries. The company is specialized in [[optical networking]] which consists of [[optical fiber]] and cables, hyper-scale network design, and deployment and network software, company deliver solutions in more than 100 countries. Data Centre & Cloud companies, Telecom operators, Internet service providers and Large enterprises collaborate with STL to build their future-ready digital infrastructure. STL's business goals are driven by customer-centricity, R&D and sustainability.{{cite web |last1=Thapliyal |first1=Aseem |title=At record high, Sterlite Technologies shares get a 62% price target hike; here's why - BusinessToday |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/stocks/story/at-record-high-sterlite-technologies-shares-get-a-62-percent-price-target-hike-heres-why-533064-2026-05-25 |publisher=[[Business Today (India)]] |language=en |date=25 May 2026}} == History == The company was founded as Sterlite Telecom Systems in March 2000, primarily engaged in the production of telecommunication cables. By August 2000, the company's name was changed to Sterlite Optical Technologies.{{Cite web |title=Latest Sterlite Technologies Ltd News, Photos, Latest News Headlines about Sterlite Technologies Ltd-The Hindu BusinessLine |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/stocks/sterlite-technologies-ltd/about |access-date=2023-04-29 |website=www.thehindubusinessline.com |language=en}} During the fiscal year 2005–2006, the company raised its installed capacity for Fiber Optic Cables from 1.4 million FKM to 2.4 million FKM. Additionally, in the same year, the company initiated a new project to manufacture Broadband Access Networks. Between 2006 and 2007, the company expanded its installed capacity for Copper Telecom Cables by 2 million CKM to reach a total of 9.5 million CKM. Similarly, the capacity for Fiber Optic Cables was raised by 822,528 FKM to reach 3,222,528 FKM, and the capacity for Broadband Access Networks was increased by 120,000 to reach 720,000. In 2007, the name of the company again changed to Sterlite Technologies.{{Cite web |title=Sterlite Technologie: Reports, Company History, Directors Report, Chairman's Speech, Auditors Report of Sterlite Technologie - NDTV |url=https://www.ndtv.com/business |access-date=2023-04-29 |website=www.ndtv.com |language=en}} == Operations == As of 2023, the company operates manufacturing facilities in 6 different locations, including [[Aurangabad]] and [[Pune]] in [[Maharashtra]], [[Silvassa]] in [[Dadra and Nagar Haveli|Dadra & Nagar Haveli]], and [[Haridwar]] in [[Uttarakhand]]. It has the first optical fiber cable plant in India to receive [[zero waste]] to [[landfill]] certification{{Cite web |date=2019-03-04 |title=Sterlite Tech is 1st OFC plant in India to receive Zero Waste to Landfill certification |url=https://www.asianage.com/technology/in-other-news/040319/sterlite-tech-is-1st-ofc-plant-in-india-to-receive-zero-waste-to-landfill-certification.html |access-date=2019-09-24 |website=The Asian Age}} The Aurangabad plants, located in [[Waluj MIDC]] and [[Shendra MIDC]], primarily specialize in the production of single mode optical fibers that transmit signals at 1490 nm wavelength in compliance with internet communication standards.{{Cite thesis |last=Sardet |first=Maëlle J. |date=February 2023 |title=A Data-Driven Approach to Improve Optical Fiber Manufacturing: Focus on Core Deposition |url=https://dspace.mit.edu/handle/1721.1/150220 |website=DSpace@MIT |publisher=[[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] |page=25|hdl=1721.1/150220 }} As of 2020, STL invested in 5G assembling ecosystem as a part of [[Make in India]] initiative.{{Cite web |date=2020-07-23 |title=Sterlite Tech says investing in 5G to develop Make in India ecosystem – ET Telecom |url=https://telecom.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/stl-says-investing-in-5g-to-develop-make-in-india-ecosystem/77128059 |website=telecom.economictimes.indiatimes.com}} As of 2026, the company operates manufacturing facilities in 10 different locations, including Aurangabad in Maharashtra, [[Silvassa]] in Dadra & Nagar Haveli in India, South Carolina in the US, [[Haimen, Nantong|Haimen]] in China, [[Brescia]] and [[Origgio]] in Italy.{{cite web |title=Sterlite Tech to buy Italian optical cable firm for €47 million |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/info-tech/sterlite-tech-to-buy-italian-optical-cable-firm-for-47-million/article24354094.ece |publisher=[[Business Line]] |language=en |date=6 July 2018}} === Geographical presence === Along with these manufacturing sites, STL has 2 development centres and 20+ sales and marketing offices across the world as of March 31, 2018, with major presence in Australia, Brazil, China, Europe (Italy), the Middle East and the United States.{{Cite web |title=Transmission Network Provider enabling Bharatnet - STL |url=https://www.stl.tech/about_us |access-date=2019-09-24 |website=stl.tech}} == Research and development == STL researches, conceptualizes, and manufactures telecommunications and specialized optical fibers.{{Cite web |last=Aulakh |first=Gulveen |date=2022-06-14 |title=Sterlite Technologies in talks with telcos for open-RAN 5G |url=https://www.livemint.com/industry/telecom/sterlite-technologies-in-talks-with-telcos-for-open-ran-5g-11655229280385.html |access-date=2023-06-22 |website=mint |language=en}} As per the [[Cellular Operators Association of India]], it is the sole domestic firm that has cable production standards on par with the global level through substantial investments in research and development, as well as intellectual property advancements.{{Cite book |last=Hsueh |first=Roselyn |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=GKZ3EAAAQBAJ&dq=Sterlite+Technologies&pg=PA200 |title=Micro-institutional Foundations of Capitalism |date=2022-06-30 |publisher=[[Cambridge University Press]] |isbn=978-1-108-63549-3 |pages=200 |language=en}} In 2019, the company partnered with the Department of Electrical Engineering, [[Indian Institute of Technology, Madras]] by signing a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to support a 5G network research professorship. Since 2020, the professor in this position has been teaching and researching on 5G technology by combining IIT-M's research and domain knowledge with STL's industry expertise.{{Cite news |date=2019-12-10 |title=IIT-Madras partners with Sterlite Technologies for 5G research and development |work=The Times of India control, and disclosure.{{Cite web |date=2023-03-06 |title=STL announces adoption of science-based target initiatives to be net-zero by 2030 |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/stocks/stl-sterlite-tech-science-based-target-initiatives-net-zero-ambition-by-2030-16103381.htm |access-date=2023-05-29 |website=cnbctv18.com |language=en}}{{Cite |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/achieved-100-zero-waste-to-landfill-stamp-for-production-units-says-sterlite-technologies/article66874858.ece |access-date=2023-05-29 |issn=0971-751X}} Regarding its carbon footprint, the company reported a total of 237,035 tCO2 emissions in the fiscal year 2022, encompassing Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions. === Wastewater management === In 2022, STL implemented the [[zero liquid discharge]] framework at its six manufacturing plants in Aurangabad and Silvassa, Maharashtra. The company recycled over 145,000 cubic meters of wastewater in the same fiscal year as part of this initiative. The process includes [[sewage treatment]], [[industrial wastewater treatment]], and multi-effective evaporator (MEE) plants. These operations are digitally monitored through [[SCADA]] dashboards.{{Cite web |date=2022-10-19 |title=Sterlite Technologies bags 'zero liquid discharge' certification |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/sterlite-technologies-bags-zero-liquid-discharge-certification/article66029920.ece |access-date=2023-05-29 |website=www.thehindubusinessline.com Controversies == In 2002, Sterlite Technologies Limited was the subject of a major lawsuit,[http://www.ofsoptics.com/press_room/view_press_release.php?txtID=136 www.ofsoptics.com press release] by Fitel USA, a subsidiary of [[Furukawa Electric]] charging Sterlite Technologies Limited with infringement of a number of optical fiber patents including those related to manufacturing fiber with low polarization mode dispersion. This lawsuit was settled in Jan 2010.{{Cite press release|url=https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ofs-and-sterlite-settle-lawsuit-81345622.html|title=OFS and Sterlite Settle Lawsuit|last=OFS|agency=PR Newswire|language=en|access-date=2019-11-04}} In 2024, a district court of [[Columbia, South Carolina]] ruled that Sterlite Technologies unjustly benefited from acquiring [[Prysmian Group]]'s trade secrets and awarded $96.5 million in damages against the company.{{Cite news |date=16 August 2024 |title=US court asks Vedanta-backed Sterlite Tech to pay $96.5 mn to Prysmian |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/us-court-asks-vedanta-backed-sterlite-tech-to-pay-96-5-mn-to-prysmian-124081600831_1.html |access-date=16 August 2024 |work=[[Business Standard]]}}{{Cite news |date=16 August 2024 |title=US court orders Vedanta Group-owned Sterlite Tech to pay ₹810 crore to Prysmian for violating trade secrets: Report |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/us-court-orders-vedanta-group-owned-sterlite-te |access-date=16 August 2024 |work=[[Mint (newspaper)|Mint]]}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links == *[https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1370431/000114554906001634/u92827bfv1za.htm#105 Amended F-1 registration statement] for Sterlite Industries (India) Limited filed with the U.S. [[Securities and Exchange Commission]] {{Vedanta Resources}} {{Glass makers and brands}} {{Telecommunication companies of India}} [[Category:Glassmaking companies of India]] [[Category:Electronics companies of India]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies based in Gurgaon]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1988]] [[Category:Indian brands]] [[Category:1988 establishments in Maharashtra]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies established in 1988]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]

The company is specialized in optical networking which consists of optical fiber and cables, hyper-scale network design, and deployment and network software, company deliver solutions in more than 100 countries. Data Centre & Cloud companies, Telecom operators, Internet service providers and Large enterprises collaborate with STL to build their future-ready digital infrastructure. STL's business goals are driven by customer-centricity, R&D and sustainability.
